definition: Absolute world-frame full obstacle multiset; names/order ignored; 1e-8 numeric rounding; box x/y label and pi/pi2 yaw symmetry normalized; cylinder/sphere yaw ignored. Spawn/region differences reported separately. No arbitrary global translation/rotation equivalence claimed.
near_definition: Diagnostic only: same obstacle shapes, same xy within1e-6m and bottom height rounded1mm, box yaw equal modulo pi; all relative dimension discrepancies abs(a-b)/max(abs(a),abs(b)) <=5%. Not an adoption/exclusion rule.
